verdict.rationale: An OpenAPI spec is published at https://cactuscompute.com/v1/openapi.json; the cited description ('Generate tool-calling training data, fine-tune Needle 3, and download the resulting models') comes from that file. It sits alongside agent-oriented llms.txt and llms/api docs that describe the REST endpoints. The probe's 404s only covered unversioned or well-known paths, not the /v1/ path, so they do not contradict the spec's existence. Missing for 10: the spec is not discoverable at standard or well-known locations, and there is no hands-on or independent confirmation of its completeness or validity.
